## Metalomics correlation with the diet

```{r}
omic_dt <- multi_omics

diet_metals <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("../../inputs/Metallomics/metallomics_raw.xlsx",
                                    sheet = "diets", rowNames = TRUE)
rownames(diet_metals) <- gsub("CTR", "CNT", rownames(diet_metals))

dt_metals <- experiments(omic_dt[,,c("Metallomics.cecum", "Metallomics.liver")])

cor_mat <- lapply(dt_metals, function(exp_dt){
    diet_metals_long <- diet_metals[as.character(exp_dt$group), rownames(exp_dt)]
    # plotly::plot_ly(z = cor(t(assay(exp_dt)), diet_metals_long))
    return(diag(cor(t(assay(exp_dt)), diet_metals_long)))
})
names(cor_mat) <- names(dt_metals)
cor_dt <- lapply(names(cor_mat), function(x){
    data.frame("cor" = abs(cor_mat[[x]]), "organ" = x)
})
cor_dt <- do.call(rbind, cor_dt)

pdf(paste0(params$output_dir, "diet_metals_correlations_boxplot.pdf"))
boxplot(cor ~ organ, cor_dt)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
filtered_exps <- lapply(names(multi_omics), function(multi_omics_names){
    multi_omics_exp <- experiments(multi_omics)[[multi_omics_names]]
    p_val_dt <- rowData(multi_omics_exp)[,grepl("adj.p.value", colnames(rowData(multi_omics_exp)))]
    p_val_dt <- p_val_dt[,grepl("HFD-CNT|INT-HFD|INT-CNT", colnames(p_val_dt))]
    multi_omics_exp <- multi_omics_exp[apply(as.matrix(p_val_dt) <= 0.05, 1, any),]
    
    if(nrow(multi_omics_exp) == 0){return(NA)}
    
    multi_omics_exp
})
names(filtered_exps) <- names(multi_omics)
filtered_exps[is.na(filtered_exps)] <- NULL

experiments(multi_omics) <- ExperimentList(filtered_exps)
multi_omics_selected <- multi_omics_selected[multi_omics_selected %in% names(multi_omics)]
```

```{r}
omic_names_dup <- sapply(strsplit(multi_omics_ordered, "\\."), 
                        function(x){x[[1]]})
omic_names_dup[grep("cogs", multi_omics_ordered)] <- "cogs"
omic_names_dup[grep("EC", multi_omics_ordered)] <- "EC"
omic_names_dup[grep("metaerg_kegg", multi_omics_ordered)] <- "metaerg_kegg"
omic_names_dup[grep("metaerg_pathway", multi_omics_ordered)] <- "metaerg_pathway"

names(omic_names_dup) <- multi_omics_ordered

unique_omics <- unique(omic_names_dup)

omic_colors <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = length(unique_omics), name = "Set3")


col_list <- lapply(seq_along(unique_omics), function(omic_id){
    omic_name <- unique_omics[omic_id]
    
    colors_found <- names(omic_names_dup)[omic_names_dup == omic_name]
        
    
    omic_num <- length(colors_found)
    omic_col <- omic_colors[omic_id]
    
    col_ramp <- colorRampPalette(colors = c(omic_col, "white"))(omic_num + 1)[seq_len(omic_num)]
    names(col_ramp) <- colors_found
    return(col_ramp)
})

color_vect <- unlist(col_list)
omic_color_dict <- color_vect
```


```{r}
group_var <- "group"
sample_var <- "samplename"

selected_exps <- multi_omics[,colData(multi_omics)$group != "HFE", multi_omics_selected]

plot_dt <- lapply(names(experiments(selected_exps)), function(omic_name){
    omic_cd <- data.frame("sample_name" = colnames(experiments(selected_exps)[[omic_name]]))
    omic_cd$var_id <- omic_name
    omic_cd$value <- 1
    omic_cd
})
plot_dt <- do.call(rbind, plot_dt)
plot_dt$sample_name <- factor(plot_dt$sample_name)

group_var_dict <- colData(multi_omics)[[group_var]]
names(group_var_dict) <- colData(multi_omics)[[sample_var]]

sample_levels <- levels(plot_dt$sample_name)
reordered_sample_levels <- sample_levels[order(group_var_dict[as.character(sample_levels)])]

plot_dt$sample_name <- reorder(plot_dt$sample_name, 
                                new.order = reordered_sample_levels)

omic_color_dict_mod <- omic_color_dict
names(omic_color_dict_mod) <- omic_names_dict[as.character(names(omic_color_dict))]


plot_dt$var_id <- factor(omic_names_dict[as.character(plot_dt$var_id)])
plot_dt$var_id <- reorder(plot_dt$var_id, 
                        new.order = levels(plot_dt$var_id)[match(rev(omic_names_dict[omic_names_dict %in%
                                                                levels(plot_dt$var_id)]),
                                            levels(plot_dt$var_id))])

x_colors <- group_color_dict[as.character(group_var_dict[levels(plot_dt$sample_name)])]

# plot_nw_term(omic_dt = plot_dt)
ggplot(plot_dt, aes(x = sample_name, fill = var_id, y = var_id)) + 
            geom_tile() + 
            theme_minimal() + 
            theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, 
                                             colour = x_colors),
                  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5),
                    legend.position = "none", 
                    legend.justification = "top", 
                    legend.title = element_blank(), 
                    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
                    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm"), 
                  legend.text = element_text(size = 6), legend.key.size = unit(1, "line")) + 
            ggtitle("Omic Overview") + 
            xlab(NULL) + ylab(NULL) +
            scale_fill_manual(values = omic_color_dict_mod)
```





## Run MOFA2

We have a multi-omic dataset with over 35 datasets, including the different levels of hierarchy for the 16S and Shotgun Metagenomics and the different annotations for the functional metagenomics results.

We visualized the principal component analysis for each individual omic to have a vision of the data and select which datasets from the hierarchical levels and the functional metagenomics. With the results we choose to keep the Species hierarchy level and for the functional metagenomics the COGS and metaerg-kegg annotations.

We also applied a p-value threshold of 0.05 in any of the contrast to filter variables and match the results from the whole genome bisulphite that, because we used the DSS method that finds DMRs from clusters of statistically significant CpGs were already biased.

Thus, the MOFA model will help us find correlated feature patterns in the statistically significant data.

We can look at the resulting html file and we can the that all most of the variance for all the omics data is captured by the two first factors and the third one is biased towards the RNA-Seq. This makes sense because we have big differences in variable size between all the omics, this phenomena is difficult to avoid because we have many omics with very low values, even if we didn't apply a filter, thus, as the first two factors, surprisingly don't seem to be affected by this effect, and we have all the omics represented at least with a 20% of explained variance in these, we decided to proceed with it.

The factor boxplots show quite clearly two different patterns in the data, the first factor, represents features which change by the high fat diet (HFD) and are restored to similar levels by the intervention (INT); the second one shows features that are affected by HFD but the intervention fails to restore to control levels, keeping their levels changed.

Correlating these factors with the explained variance of each omic, we can see many omics biased towards one of both factors thus, we can propose that the liver histone hodifications, metallomics, targeted metabolomics and methylomics (WGB); serum targeted metabolomics and the cecum and colon functional metagenomics KEGG have a higher variance explained in the first factor thus, are the omics with the most significant features that are restored by the intervention and the cecum metallomics and targeted metabolomics are biased toward the second factor, thus they are changed by the HFD and kept mostly unchanged by the intervention.

These correlations with the first factor correlation reveal that epigenetic signatures, when affected by the high fat diet, are mostly restored to control levels after a life-style intervention, and the histone modifications and targeted metabolomics, which focused on epigenetically relevant metabolites.

All the remaining omics: the liver untargeted metabolomics, rna-sequencing and the colon and cecum metagenomics and functional clusters of orthologous groups of proteins, have even weights indicating that they contain features that can explain the variance in both factors.

Interestingly most of the metagenomics data, except the kegg functions show this pattern with the transcriptomics and untargeted metabolomics.

Looking at the weights of each feature in these factors we can see which of them are most important in explaining these patterns of the data. We looked at the absolute value distribution of weights for each omic and used as threshold for variable selection a percentage of features proportional to the variance explained of each omic in each factor.

We applied an overrepresentation analysis (ORA) to the significant genes and differentially methylated regions from each weight, dividing them into three subset: all the weights and dividing it into positive and negative weights.

#### Factor omic table

```{r}
output_dir <- paste0(params$output_dir, "MOFA_Results/", mofa_dir_name, "/")
omic_dt <- readRDS(paste0(output_dir, "multi_omics_filtered.rds"))

factor_table <- lapply(seq_len(num_factors), function(factor_id){
    exp_table <- lapply(names(experiments(omic_dt)), function(exp_name){
        exp_dt <- experiments(omic_dt)[[exp_name]]
        
        table_dt <- data.frame("Freq" = sum(rowData(exp_dt)[[paste0("Factor_", factor_id, "_weights_sig")]]),
                                "Var1" = exp_name)
        
        table_dt$factor_id <- paste0("Factor ", factor_id)
        table_dt$omic_color <- omic_color_dict[as.character(table_dt$Var1)]
         
        table_dt$Var1 <- factor(omic_names_dict[as.character(table_dt$Var1)],
                                levels = omic_names_dict)
        table_dt
    })
    exp_table <- do.call(rbind, exp_table)
    exp_table$relFreq <- exp_table$Freq/sum(exp_table$Freq)
    exp_table
})
factor_table <- do.call(rbind, factor_table)
```


```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
pdf(paste0(output_dir, "factor_omics_data.pdf"))
ggplot(factor_table) + geom_col(aes(x = factor_id, y = Freq, fill = Var1)) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = omic_color_dict_mod) + theme_minimal() + 
    theme(legend.title = element_blank()) + ylab("Count") + xlab(NULL)

ggplot(factor_table) + geom_col(aes(x = factor_id, y = relFreq, fill = Var1)) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = omic_color_dict_mod) + theme_minimal() +  
    theme(legend.title = element_blank()) + ylab("Frequency") + xlab(NULL)
dev.off()
```

## Enrich information

```{r}
output_dir <- paste0(params$output_dir, "MOFA_Results/", mofa_dir_name, "/")
omic_dt <- readRDS(paste0(output_dir, "multi_omics_filtered.rds"))

omic_enrich <- c("Untargeted_Metabolomics", "RNA_Sequencing", "WGB_DNA_Methylation")
ids_enrich_names <- c("compounds_kegg_merged", "entrezID", "geneId")

library(SummarizedExperiment)

## Enrich IDs dictionary
omic_dict_list <- mapply(function(omic_id, enrich_var){
    
    omic_data <- omic_dt[[omic_id]]
    omic_dict <- strsplit(rowData(omic_data)[[enrich_var]], ";")
    
    names(omic_dict) <- paste0(omic_id, ".", rownames(omic_data))
    
    omic_dict
    
}, omic_id = omic_enrich, enrich_var = ids_enrich_names)

rna_seq_rd <- lapply(experiments(omic_dt)[c("RNA_Sequencing", "WGB_DNA_Methylation", "Untargeted_Metabolomics")], rowData)
num_factors <- 2
## Universe IDs mapped
universe_list_ids <- lapply(names(rna_seq_rd), function(omic_name){
    omic_ids <- omic_dict_list[[omic_name]][paste0(omic_name, ".", rownames(rna_seq_rd[[omic_name]]))]
    omic_ids <- omic_ids[!is.null(omic_ids)]
    omic_ids <- unlist(omic_ids)
    omic_ids[!is.na(omic_ids)]

})
names(universe_list_ids) <- names(rna_seq_rd)
```

```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)
kegg_db_enrich_path <- paste0(params$output_dir, "kegg_enrich_db_red.rds")
kegg_db_list <- readRDS(kegg_db_enrich_path)
term2name_dt <- kegg_db_list$term2name
integ_enrich_db <- kegg_db_list$term2gene
membership_attribute <- "cluster_ids"
min_n <- 10
# enrich_name <- "gsea_part_kegg"
```

```{r}
col_names <- paste0("Factor_", seq_len(num_factors))

omic_enrich <- c("Untargeted_Metabolomics", "RNA_Sequencing",
                 "WGB_DNA_Methylation")
ids_enrich_names <- c("compounds_kegg_merged", "entrezID", "geneId")

fc_dict <- lapply(col_names, function(col_name){
    col_name <- paste0(col_name, "_weights")
    # 
    omic_fc_dict <- mapply(function(omic_id, enrich_var){
        omic_data <- omic_dt[[omic_id]]
        omic_dict <- rowData(omic_data)[[enrich_var]]
        
        fc_dt <- rowData(omic_data)[[col_name]]
        
        names(omic_dict) <- paste0(omic_id, ".", rownames(omic_data))
        
        omic_fc <- mapply(function(var_names, fc_vect){
            var_names_split <- strsplit(var_names, ";")[[1]]
            var_names_split <- var_names_split[!is.na(var_names_split)]
            if(!length(var_names_split)){return(NULL)}
            fc_vect_dict <- rep(fc_vect, length(var_names_split))
            names(fc_vect_dict) <- var_names_split
            fc_vect_dict
        }, var_names = omic_dict, fc_vect = fc_dt, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
        
        unlist(omic_fc)
    }, omic_id = omic_enrich, enrich_var = ids_enrich_names)
    
    omic_fc_dict
})
names(fc_dict) <- col_names
```


```{r}
weight_table <- prop.table(table(integ_enrich_db$term, integ_enrich_db$type), margin = 1)

# universe_m <- unlist(Reduce(c, universe_list_ids["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]))
# universe_g <- unlist(Reduce(c, universe_list_ids[c("RNA_Sequencing", "WGB_DNA_Methylation")]))

corr_scores <- c("spearman", "pearson")

set.seed(1234)
enrich_results_partial_gsea <- lapply(names(fc_dict), function(factor_id){
    
    factor_dt <- fc_dict[[factor_id]]
    
    ids_m <- sort(factor_dt[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]], decreasing = TRUE)
    
    ids_g <- factor_dt[["RNA_Sequencing"]]
    ids_d <- factor_dt[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]]
    
    ids_g <- sort(c(ids_g, ids_d), decreasing = TRUE)
    
    enrich_m <- GSEA(gene = ids_m, 
                        pvalueCutoff = 1, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                        TERM2GENE = integ_enrich_db[integ_enrich_db$type == "metabolite_id",], 
                        TERM2NAME = term2name_dt)
    enrich_g <- GSEA(gene = ids_g, 
                        pvalueCutoff = 1, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                        TERM2GENE = integ_enrich_db[integ_enrich_db$type == "gene_id",], 
                        TERM2NAME = term2name_dt)
    
    # enrich_c <- GSEA(gene = sort(c(ids_m, ids_g), decreasing = TRUE), 
    #                     pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
    #                     TERM2GENE = integ_enrich_db, 
    #                     TERM2NAME = term2name_dt)
    
    if(is.null(enrich_m) & is.null(enrich_g)){
        return(NULL)
    } else if(!is.null(enrich_m) & is.null(enrich_g)){
        enrich_m <- setReadable_custom(enrich_m, 
                                       featureDict = omic_dict_list$Untargeted_Metabolomics, "gsea")
        return(list("CL_1" = enrich_m))
    } else if(!is.null(enrich_g) & is.null(enrich_m)){
        enrich_g <- setReadable_custom(enrich_g, featureDict = ids_g)
        return(list("CL_1" = enrich_g))
    }
    enrich_m <- setReadable_custom(enrich_m, featureDict = omic_dict_list$Untargeted_Metabolomics, 
                                   dt_type = "gsea")
    enrich_g <- setReadable_custom(enrich_g, featureDict = c(omic_dict_list$RNA_Sequencing,
                                                             omic_dict_list$WGB_DNA_Methylation), 
                                   dt_type = "gsea")

    merged_enrich <- dplyr::full_join(x = enrich_g@result, y = enrich_m@result, by = "ID")
     
    merged_enrich$core_enrichment <- paste(merged_enrich$core_enrichment.x, 
                                  merged_enrich$core_enrichment.y, 
                                sep = "/")
    merged_enrich$pvalue <- sapply(merged_enrich$ID, function(id){
        p_vals <- merged_enrich[merged_enrich$ID == id, 
                                c("pvalue.x", "pvalue.y")]
        survcomp::combine.test(p = p_vals, 
                               weight = weight_table[id,], 
                               method = "logit", 
                               na.rm = T)    
    })
    merged_enrich$p.adjust <- p.adjust(merged_enrich$pvalue, 
                                                method = "fdr")
    merged_enrich$qvalue <- NA
    # merged_enrich$Count <- rowSums(cbind(merged_enrich$Count.x,
    #                                     merged_enrich$Count.y), 
    #                                 na.rm = TRUE)
    # 
    merged_enrich$Description <- merged_enrich$Description.x
    merged_enrich$Description[is.na(merged_enrich$Description)] <- merged_enrich$Description.y[is.na(merged_enrich$Description)]
    
    merged_enrich$setSize <- rowSums(cbind(merged_enrich$setSize.x, merged_enrich$setSize.y), na.rm = T)
    
    # merged_enrich$GeneRatio <- mapply(FUN = function(x, y){
    #     if(any(is.na(x))){return(paste(y, collapse = "/"))}
    #     if(any(is.na(y))){return(paste(x, collapse = "/"))}
    #     paste(sum(as.numeric(x[1]), as.numeric(y[1]), na.rm = TRUE),
    #         sum(as.numeric(x[2]), as.numeric(y[2]), na.rm = TRUE), sep = "/")
    # }, x = strsplit(merged_enrich$GeneRatio.x, "/"), 
    #     y = strsplit(merged_enrich$GeneRatio.y, "/"))
    
    enrich_g@result <- merged_enrich[merged_enrich$p.adjust <= 0.05,]
    list("CL_1" = enrich_g)
    # merged_enrich[merged_enrich$p.adjust <= 0.05,]
})
names(enrich_results_partial_gsea) <- names(fc_dict)

results_wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
lapply(names(enrich_results_partial_gsea), function(factor_id){
    factor_dt <- enrich_results_partial_gsea[[factor_id]]$CL_1
    factor_dt <- fortify(factor_dt, showCategory = nrow(factor_dt@result))
    
    sheet_name <- factor_id
    openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb = results_wb,
                            sheetName = sheet_name)
    openxlsx::writeData(wb = results_wb, sheet = sheet_name,
                        x = factor_dt[order(factor_dt$p.adjust, 
                                            decreasing = FALSE),])
    openxlsx::saveWorkbook(results_wb, 
                            file = paste0(output_dir, "enrich_gsea_results.xlsx"), 
                            overwrite = TRUE)
})
```

```{r}
omic_dt <- multi_omics[,,!grepl("16S|Phylum|Genus|Class|Family|Order", names(multi_omics))]

score_thr <- 0.7

weight_cols <- paste0("Factor_", c("1", "2"), "_weights", 
            c("", "", "_sig", "_sig"))

mofa_prop_abs <- lapply(mofa_w_abs, function(x){
    omic_props <- as.data.frame(t(apply(x, 1, function(x){abs(x)/sum(abs(x))})))
    
    # factor_max <- apply(omic_props, 1, function(x){
    #     found <- which(x >= score_thr)
    #     if(length(found)){return(found)} else{return(0)}
    # })
    max_f_dt <- lapply(omic_props, function(x){
        x >= score_thr
    })
    
    max_f_dt <- do.call(cbind, max_f_dt)
    max_f_dt <- cbind(as.data.frame(x), max_f_dt)
    colnames(max_f_dt) <- weight_cols
    max_f_dt
})

exp_list <- lapply(names(experiments(omic_dt)), function(omic_name){
    omic_exp <- experiments(omic_dt)[[omic_name]]
    if(omic_name %in% names(mofa_prop_abs)){
        rowData(omic_exp) <- cbind(rowData(omic_exp), mofa_prop_abs[[omic_name]])
    } else{
        rowData(omic_exp)[weight_cols[1:2]] <- NA
        rowData(omic_exp)[weight_cols[3:4]] <- TRUE    
    }
    omic_exp
})
names(exp_list) <- names(omic_dt)
experiments(omic_dt) <- ExperimentList(exp_list)

omic_combn <- lapply(omic_int, function(x){
    t(data.frame(x, omic_nint))
})

network_omics <- list("Pairwise full liver" = omic_combn)

saveRDS(omic_dt, paste0(output_dir, "multi_omics_filtered_mod.rds"))
```

### Correlation filter

```{r}
rand_seed <- 1234
universe_list <- lapply(nw_graphs, function(score_dt){
    lapply(score_dt, function(graph_dt){
        names(V(graph_dt))
    })
})

nw_graphs <- lapply(names(nw_graphs), function(score_id){
    score_dt <- nw_graphs[[score_id]]
    score_res <- lapply(names(score_dt), function(graph_id){
        graph_dt <- score_dt[[graph_id]]

        graph_weights <- abs(edge_attr(graph_dt,
                        name = "weight"))
        graph_adj.p.val <- edge_attr(graph_dt, name = "adj.p.value")
        subgraph.edges(graph_dt,
                    E(graph_dt)[graph_weights >= score_filters[score_id] & graph_adj.p.val <= 0.05],
                    delete.vertices = FALSE)
    })
    names(score_res) <- names(score_dt)
    score_res
})
```

```{r}
overlap_list <- lapply(names(nw_graphs), function(score_id){

    score_dt <- nw_graphs[[score_id]]
    
    factor_dt <- lapply(names(score_dt), function(factor_id){
        factor_dt <- score_dt[[factor_id]]
        factor_dt <- subgraph(graph = factor_dt, 
                            vids = names(V(factor_dt))[igraph::degree(factor_dt) != 0])
        keep_nodes <- names(V(factor_dt))[!grepl("Untargeted|RNA_Sequencing|WGB_DNA", 
                                    vertex_attr(factor_dt, name = "Node_Omic"))]
        
        
    })
    list("Overlap" = length(intersect(factor_dt[[1]], factor_dt[[2]])), 
        "Total F1" = length(factor_dt[[1]]), "F1" = setdiff(factor_dt[[1]], factor_dt[[2]]),
        "Total F2" = length(factor_dt[[2]]), "F2" = setdiff(factor_dt[[2]], factor_dt[[1]]),
        "Overlap_Names" = intersect(factor_dt[[1]], factor_dt[[2]]))
})
```

```{r}
de_overlapped_features <- lapply(names(nw_graphs), function(score_id){

    score_dt <- nw_graphs[[score_id]]
    
    factor_dt <- lapply(names(score_dt), function(factor_id){
        factor_dt <- score_dt[[factor_id]]
        factor_dt <- subgraph(graph = factor_dt, 
                            vids = names(V(factor_dt))[igraph::degree(factor_dt) != 0])
        keep_nodes <- names(V(factor_dt))[!grepl("Untargeted|RNA_Sequencing|WGB_DNA", 
                                    vertex_attr(factor_dt, name = "Node_Omic"))]
        
        data.frame("nodes" = keep_nodes, 
                   "degree" = igraph::degree(factor_dt, keep_nodes), 
                   "omic" = vertex_attr(factor_dt, "Node_Omic", index = keep_nodes),
                   "factor" = factor_id)
    })
    
    factor_merged <- dplyr::full_join(factor_dt[[1]], factor_dt[[2]], by = "nodes")
    
    factor_merged$max_factor <- apply(factor_merged[c("degree.x", "degree.y")], 1, which.max)
    factor_merged$omic <- apply(factor_merged[c("omic.x", "omic.y")], 1,
                                function(x){unique(x[!is.na(x)])})
    
    factor_mod <- lapply(unique(factor_merged$max_factor),
                            function(factor_id){
                                factor_merged[factor_merged$max_factor == factor_id,]
                            })    
    names(factor_mod) <- paste0("Factor_", unique(factor_merged$max_factor))
    factor_mod
})
names(de_overlapped_features) <- names(nw_graphs)
saveRDS(de_overlapped_features, 
        paste0(corr_output_dir, "de_overlapped_features.rds"))
```

#### Full enrichment

```{r}
clu_ids_enrich <- lapply(nw_graphs, function(score_dt){
    lapply(score_dt, function(graph_dt){
        membership_vector <- vertex_attr(graph_dt, membership_attribute)
        clu_vertex <- lapply(unique(membership_vector), function(cl_id){
            names(V(graph_dt))[membership_vector == cl_id]
        })
        names(clu_vertex) <- unique(membership_vector)
        cluster_id_list <-  lapply(clu_vertex, function(clu_ids){
            if(length(clu_ids) <= min_n){return(NA)}
            metabo_dt <- omic_dict_list[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]][grep("Untargeted_Metabolomics",
                                                                        clu_ids, value = T)]
            metabo_dt <- metabo_dt[!is.null(metabo_dt)]

            metabo_dt <- metabo_dt[!is.na(metabo_dt)]

            wgb_dt <- omic_dict_list[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]][grep("WGB_DNA_Methylation",
                                                                    clu_ids, value = T)]
            wgb_dt <- wgb_dt[!is.null(wgb_dt) & !is.na(wgb_dt)]

            rna_dt <- omic_dict_list[["RNA_Sequencing"]][grep("RNA_Sequencing",
                                                            clu_ids, value = T)]
            rna_dt <- rna_dt[!is.null(rna_dt) & !is.na(rna_dt)]

            return(list("Untargeted_Metabolomics" = metabo_dt,
                        "RNA_Sequencing" = rna_dt,
                        "WGB_DNA_Methylation" = wgb_dt))
        })
        cluster_id_list[!is.na(cluster_id_list)]
    })
})
```

```{r}
clu_ids_enrich <- lapply(seq_len(num_factors), function(factor_id){
    omic_names <- c("Untargeted_Metabolomics", "WGB_DNA_Methylation", "RNA_Sequencing")
    clu_ids <- lapply(omic_names, function(omic_id){
        omic_exp <- experiments(omic_dt)[[omic_id]]
        features_factor <- rownames(rowData(omic_exp))[rowData(omic_exp)[[paste0("Factor_", 
                                                            factor_id, "_weights_sig")]]]
        paste0(omic_id, ".", features_factor)
    })
    names(clu_ids) <- omic_names
    
    metabo_dt <- omic_dict_list[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]][clu_ids$Untargeted_Metabolomics]
    metabo_dt <- metabo_dt[!is.null(metabo_dt)]
    metabo_dt <- metabo_dt[!is.na(metabo_dt)]

    wgb_dt <- omic_dict_list[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]][clu_ids$WGB_DNA_Methylation]
    wgb_dt <- wgb_dt[!is.null(wgb_dt) & !is.na(wgb_dt)]
    
    rna_dt <- omic_dict_list[["RNA_Sequencing"]][clu_ids$RNA_Sequencing]
    rna_dt <- rna_dt[!is.null(rna_dt) & !is.na(rna_dt)]
    
    return(list("Untargeted_Metabolomics" = metabo_dt, 
                "RNA_Sequencing" = rna_dt, 
                "WGB_DNA_Methylation" = wgb_dt))
})
```

```{r}
    col_name <- paste0(col_name, "_weights")
    # 
    omic_fc_dict <- mapply(function(omic_id, enrich_var){
        omic_data <- omic_dt[[omic_id]]
        omic_dict <- rowData(omic_data)[[enrich_var]]
        
        fc_dt <- rowData(omic_data)[[col_name]]
        
        names(omic_dict) <- paste0(omic_id, ".", rownames(omic_data))
        
        omic_fc <- mapply(function(var_names, fc_vect){
            var_names_split <- strsplit(var_names, ";")[[1]]
            var_names_split <- var_names_split[!is.na(var_names_split)]
            if(!length(var_names_split)){return(NULL)}
            fc_vect_dict <- rep(fc_vect, length(var_names_split))
            names(fc_vect_dict) <- var_names_split
            fc_vect_dict
        }, var_names = omic_dict, fc_vect = fc_dt, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
        
        unlist(omic_fc)
    }, omic_id = omic_enrich, enrich_var = ids_enrich_names)
    
    omic_fc_dict
})
```

###### Clustered terms

```{r}
overlap_mats <- lapply(enrich_results_partial_gsea, function(factor_dt){
    gene_ids <- factor_dt$CL_1@result$geneID
    gene_ids <- strsplit(gene_ids, "/")
    
    overlap_mat <- matrix(nrow = length(gene_ids), ncol = length(gene_ids))
    for(x in seq_along(gene_ids)){
        for(y in seq_along(gene_ids)){
            overlap_mat[x, y] <- length(intersect(gene_ids[[x]], 
                                            gene_ids[[y]]))/length(union(gene_ids[[x]], 
                                                                    gene_ids[[y]]))
        }    
    }
    rownames(overlap_mat) <- factor_dt$CL_1@result$Description
    colnames(overlap_mat) <- factor_dt$CL_1@result$Description
    overlap_mat
})
corr_mat <- corrplot::corrplot(overlap_mats$Factor_1)
```

```{r}
omic_dt <- multi_omics[,,!grepl("16S|Phylum|Genus|Class|Family|Order", names(multi_omics))]

score_thr <- 0.7

weight_cols <- paste0("Factor_", c("1", "2"), "_weights", 
            c("", "", "_sig", "_sig"))

mofa_prop_abs <- lapply(mofa_w_abs, function(x){
    omic_props <- as.data.frame(t(apply(x, 1, function(x){x/sum(x)})))
    
    max_f_dt <- lapply(omic_props, function(x){
        x >= score_thr
    })
    
    max_f_dt <- do.call(cbind, max_f_dt)
    max_f_dt <- cbind(as.data.frame(omic_props), max_f_dt)
    colnames(max_f_dt) <- weight_cols
    max_f_dt
})


exp_list <- lapply(names(experiments(omic_dt)), function(omic_name){
    omic_exp <- experiments(omic_dt)[[omic_name]]
    if(omic_name %in% names(mofa_prop_abs)){
        rowData(omic_exp) <- cbind(rowData(omic_exp), mofa_prop_abs[[omic_name]])
    } else{
        rowData(omic_exp)[weight_cols[1:2]] <- NA
        rowData(omic_exp)[weight_cols[3:4]] <- TRUE    
    }
    omic_exp
})
names(exp_list) <- names(omic_dt)
experiments(omic_dt) <- ExperimentList(exp_list)


network_omics <- list("Pairwise full liver" = matrix(c("RNA_Sequencing",
                                                "WGB_DNA_Methylation"), nrow = 2, ncol = 1))

library(stringr)

rowData(experiments(omic_dt)$Untargeted_Metabolomics)$compounds_merged[is.na(rowData(experiments(omic_dt)$Untargeted_Metabolomics)$compounds_merged)] <- rowData(experiments(omic_dt)$Untargeted_Metabolomics)$PutativeMetabolites[is.na(rowData(experiments(omic_dt)$Untargeted_Metabolomics)$compounds_merged)]
```

```{r}
                                sample_levels_2_correlate = c("CNT", "HFD", "INT"),
                                filter_variable_2_correlate = list(
                                    "Factor_1" = quote(Factor_1_weights_sig),
                                    "Factor_2" = quote(Factor_2_weights_sig)
                                ),
                                p_adj_thr = 1,
                                omic_list_pairs = network_omics,
                                rowData_variable_name_list = variables_dicts,
                                draw_networks = TRUE,
                                draw_cytoscape = FALSE,
                                add_autocorrelations = FALSE,
                                keep_full_correlations = TRUE,
                                output_dir = corr_output_dir,
                                output_suffix = paste0("0_005_chi_f1f2_", corr_method),
                                add_variables = TRUE,
                                variables_names = add_var_names,
                                draw_cluster_scatter_plots = FALSE))
     )
}
```

## Correlation Analysis

```{r}
library(ProteoNet)
library(igraph)
library(dplyr)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
output_dir <- paste0(params$output_dir, "MOFA_Results/", mofa_dir_name, "/")
corr_output_dir <- paste0(output_dir, corr_output_name, "/")

# omic_dt <- readRDS(paste0(output_dir, "multi_omics_filtered.rds"))
omic_dt <- readRDS(paste0(output_dir, "multi_omics_filtered_mod.rds"))

nw_paths <- list.files(corr_output_dir, 
                       pattern = "network_results_0_005_chi_f1f2_.*\\.rds$", full.names = T)
nw_graphs <- lapply(nw_paths, readRDS)

nw_graphs <- lapply(nw_graphs, function(score_dt){
    lapply(score_dt, function(weight_dt){
        weight_dt[["Pairwise full liver"]]
    })
})
# table(vertex_attr(nw_graphs$spearman$Factor_1, "Node_Omic"))
# table(vertex_attr(nw_graphs$spearman$Factor_2, "Node_Omic"))

score_names <- gsub("\\.rds", "", sapply(strsplit(grep("network_results", 
                                                        basename(nw_paths), 
                                                        value = TRUE), "_"),
                                            function(x){x[length(x)]}))
score_filters <- c(0.8, 0.8)
names(score_filters) <- score_names
names(nw_graphs) <- score_names
```

### Correlation networks input

```{r}
feature_ids_dict <- lapply(names(variables_dicts), function(dataset_name){
    
    dataset_var <- rowData(omic_dt[[dataset_name]])[variables_dicts[[dataset_name]]]
    dataset_vector <- unlist(dataset_var[[1]])
    dataset_vector[is.na(dataset_vector)] <- paste(dataset_name, "No annotation")
    dataset_vector <- make.unique(dataset_vector, sep = ".")
    
    if(dataset_name == "WGB_DNA_Methylation"){
        dataset_vector <- paste("DMR", dataset_vector)
    }
    names(dataset_vector) <- paste0(dataset_name, ".", rownames(dataset_var))
    dataset_vector
})
names(feature_ids_dict) <- names(variables_dicts)

var_order_col_list <- lapply(nw_graphs, function(score_nw){
    factor_col <- lapply(names(score_nw), function(factor_id){
        paste0(factor_id, "_weights")    
    })
    names(factor_col) <- names(score_nw)
    factor_col
})
```

### Correlation filter

```{r}
rand_seed <- 1234
universe_list <- lapply(nw_graphs, function(score_dt){
    lapply(score_dt, function(graph_dt){
        names(V(graph_dt))
    })
})

nw_graphs <- lapply(names(nw_graphs), function(score_id){
    score_dt <- nw_graphs[[score_id]]
    score_res <- lapply(names(score_dt), function(graph_id){
        graph_dt <- score_dt[[graph_id]]

        graph_weights <- abs(edge_attr(graph_dt,
                        name = "weight"))
        graph_adj.p.val <- edge_attr(graph_dt, name = "adj.p.value")
        subgraph.edges(graph_dt,
                    E(graph_dt)[graph_weights >= score_filters[score_id] & graph_adj.p.val <= 0.05],
                    delete.vertices = FALSE)
    })
    names(score_res) <- names(score_dt)
    score_res
})
names(nw_graphs) <- score_names
```


### Extra analysis

#### Correlations RNA-Seq/DNA-Seq

```{r}
plot_list <- lapply(nw_graphs, function(score_dt){
    
    lapply(score_dt, function(factor_dt){
    
        test <- igraph::as_long_data_frame(factor_dt)
        rna_dna_omics <- c("RNA_Sequencing", "WGB_DNA_Methylation")
        
        
        rna_nodes <- names(V(factor_dt))[vertex_attr(factor_dt, name = "Node_Omic") == rna_dna_omics[1]]
        dna_nodes <- names(V(factor_dt))[vertex_attr(factor_dt, name = "Node_Omic") == rna_dna_omics[2]]
        
        test_dna_rna <- test[(test$to_Node_Omic %in% rna_dna_omics) & 
                 (test$from_Node_Omic %in% rna_dna_omics),]
        
        rna_seq_corr <- c(test_dna_rna$to_name[test_dna_rna$to_Node_Omic == rna_dna_omics[1]],
                          test_dna_rna$from_name[test_dna_rna$from_Node_Omic == rna_dna_omics[1]])
        dna_seq_corr <- c(test_dna_rna$to_name[test_dna_rna$to_Node_Omic == rna_dna_omics[2]],
                          test_dna_rna$from_name[test_dna_rna$from_Node_Omic == rna_dna_omics[2]])
        
        
        rna_table <- table(rna_seq_corr)
        dna_table <- table(dna_seq_corr)
        
        
        rna_count_dt <- data.frame("value" = as.numeric(rna_table),
                                   "value_perc" = as.numeric(rna_table)/length(dna_table),
                                    "name" = names(rna_table),
                                    "omic" = "RNA_Sequencing",
                                    "n_vars" = paste("Nt = ", length(rna_nodes),
                                                     "/ N = ", length(rna_table))
                                )
        
        dna_count_dt <- data.frame("value" = as.numeric(dna_table),
                                    "value_perc" = as.numeric(dna_table)/length(rna_table),
                                    "name" = names(dna_table),
                                    "omic" = "WGB_DNA_Methylation",
                                    "n_vars" = paste("Nt =", length(dna_nodes),
                                                     "/ N = ", length(dna_table))
                                   )
        count_merged_dt <- rbind(rna_count_dt, dna_count_dt)
        
        count_merged_dt$omic <- omic_names_dict[as.character(count_merged_dt$omic)]
        count_merged_dt
    })
})

```

What we see makes sense as we have smaller differences in DNA methylation data than in RNA-Seq data, from 602 significant DMRs to around ~10000 significant genes.

##### Correlated DMRs info

```{r}
top_n <- 25

top_dt <- lapply(plot_list, function(score_dt){
    lapply(score_dt, function(factor_dt){
        factor_dt <- factor_dt[order(factor_dt$value, 
                                         decreasing = TRUE),]
        
        top_vars <- factor_dt$name[seq_len(top_n)]
        
        rna_seq_ids <- grep("RNA_Sequencing", top_vars)
        rna_seq_vars <- gsub("RNA_Sequencing\\.", "", 
                             top_vars[rna_seq_ids])
        rna_dt <- rowData(omic_dt@ExperimentList$RNA_Sequencing)[rna_seq_vars,]
        rna_dt$num_corr <- factor_dt$value[seq_len(top_n)][rna_seq_ids]
        
        dna_seq_ids <- grep("WGB_DNA_Methylation", top_vars)
        dna_seq_vars <- gsub("WGB_DNA_Methylation\\.", "", 
                            top_vars[dna_seq_ids])
        dna_dt <- rowData(omic_dt@ExperimentList$WGB_DNA_Methylation)[dna_seq_vars,]
        dna_dt$num_corr <- factor_dt$value[seq_len(top_n)][dna_seq_ids]
        
        list("RNA_Seq" = rna_dt, "DNA_Met" = dna_dt)
    })
})

keep_cols <- list("DNA_Met" = c("annotation", "geneChr", "geneStart", 
                                "geneEnd", "geneLength", "geneStrand", "geneId",
                                "transcriptId", "distanceToTSS", "geneSymbol", 
                                "geneName", "n_overlap_CpGs", "num_corr"), 
                  "RNA_Seq" = c("gene_name", "entrezID", "symbol", 
                                "gene_lab", "num_corr"))

results_wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
lapply(names(top_dt), function(score_id){
    score_dt <- top_dt[[score_id]]

    lapply(names(score_dt), function(factor_id){
        factor_dt <- score_dt[[factor_id]]
        lapply(names(factor_dt), function(clu_id){
            sheet_name <- paste(score_id, factor_id, clu_id, sep = ".")
            clu_dt <- factor_dt[[clu_id]]

            openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb = results_wb,
                                    sheetName = sheet_name)
            openxlsx::writeData(wb = results_wb, sheet = sheet_name,
                                x = as.data.frame(clu_dt)[,keep_cols[[clu_id]]])
            openxlsx::saveWorkbook(results_wb, 
                                    file = paste0(output_dir, "top_correlated_features.xlsx"), 
                                    overwrite = TRUE)    
        })
    })
})
```

#### Circos Plot

```{r}
library(circlize)
lapply(seq_along(nw_graphs$spearman), function(factor_id){
    factor_dt <- nw_graphs$spearman[[factor_id]]
    test <- as_long_data_frame(factor_dt)
    
    test_2 <- data.frame("Omic1" = test$from_Node_Omic, 
                         "Omic2" = test$to_Node_Omic)
    test_2 <- test_2[order(test$weight),]
    
    pdf(paste0(output_dir, "merged_chord_", factor_id, ".pdf"))
    chordDiagram(test_2, 
                col = ifelse(test$weight[order(test$weight)] > 0, 
                            "salmon1", "lightblue"), 
                grid.col = omic_color_dict, annotationTrack = "grid")    
    dev.off()
})

lapply(seq_along(nw_graphs$spearman), function(factor_id){
    factor_dt <- nw_graphs$spearman[[factor_id]]
    test <- as_long_data_frame(factor_dt)
    
    test_2 <- data.frame("Omic1" = test$from_Node_Omic, 
                         "Omic2" = test$to_Node_Omic)
    pdf(paste0(output_dir, "pos_neg_chord_", factor_id, ".pdf"))
    par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
    chordDiagram(test_2[test$weight > 0,], 
                col = "salmon1", 
                grid.col = omic_color_dict, annotationTrack = "grid")    
    chordDiagram(test_2[test$weight < 0,], 
                col = "lightblue", 
                grid.col = omic_color_dict, annotationTrack = "grid")    
    dev.off()
})
```

#### Full network

```{r}
membership_attribute <- "cluster_ids"
min_n <- 10
nw_graphs <- lapply(nw_graphs, function(score_dt){
    lapply(score_dt, function(graph_dt){
        # graph_dt <- subgraph(graph_dt, clusters(graph_dt))
        # graph_dt <- decompose(graph_dt, max.comps = 1)[[1]]
        vertex_attr(graph_dt, name = membership_attribute) <- "CL_1"
        return(graph_dt)
    })
})

```

#### Full enrichment

```{r}
clu_ids_enrich <- lapply(nw_graphs, function(score_dt){
    lapply(score_dt, function(graph_dt){
        membership_vector <- vertex_attr(graph_dt, membership_attribute)
        clu_vertex <- lapply(unique(membership_vector), function(cl_id){
            names(V(graph_dt))[membership_vector == cl_id]
        })
        names(clu_vertex) <- unique(membership_vector)
        cluster_id_list <-  lapply(clu_vertex, function(clu_ids){
            if(length(clu_ids) <= min_n){return(NA)}
            metabo_dt <- omic_dict_list[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]][grep("Untargeted_Metabolomics", 
                                                                        clu_ids, value = T)]
            metabo_dt <- metabo_dt[!is.null(metabo_dt)]
             
            metabo_dt <- metabo_dt[!is.na(metabo_dt)]
            
            wgb_dt <- omic_dict_list[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]][grep("WGB_DNA_Methylation", 
                                                                    clu_ids, value = T)]
            wgb_dt <- wgb_dt[!is.null(wgb_dt) & !is.na(wgb_dt)]
            
            rna_dt <- omic_dict_list[["RNA_Sequencing"]][grep("RNA_Sequencing", 
                                                            clu_ids, value = T)]
            rna_dt <- rna_dt[!is.null(rna_dt) & !is.na(rna_dt)]
            
            return(list("Untargeted_Metabolomics" = metabo_dt, 
                        "RNA_Sequencing" = rna_dt, 
                        "WGB_DNA_Methylation" = wgb_dt))
        })
        cluster_id_list[!is.na(cluster_id_list)]
    })
})
```

##### Partial kegg joint pathway

```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)
kegg_db_enrich_path <- paste0(params$output_dir, "kegg_enrich_db.rds")
kegg_db_list <- readRDS(kegg_db_enrich_path)
term2name_dt <- kegg_db_list$term2name
integ_enrich_db <- kegg_db_list$term2gene
membership_attribute <- "cluster_ids"
min_n <- 10
enrich_name <- "factor_part_kegg"
enrich_nw_dir <- paste0(corr_output_dir, enrich_name, "/")

if(!dir.exists(enrich_nw_dir)){dir.create(enrich_nw_dir)}
```


```{r}
weight_table <- prop.table(table(integ_enrich_db$term, integ_enrich_db$type), margin = 1)

universe_m <- unlist(Reduce(c, universe_list_ids["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]))
universe_g <- unlist(Reduce(c, universe_list_ids[c("RNA_Sequencing", "WGB_DNA_Methylation")]))

enrich_results_partial <- lapply(names(clu_ids_enrich), function(factor_id){
    factor_dt <- clu_ids_enrich[[factor_id]]
    factor_res <- lapply(names(factor_dt), function(weight_id){
        weight_dt <- factor_dt[[weight_id]]
        lapply(weight_dt, function(clu_dt){
            
            ids_m <- Reduce(c, clu_dt["Untargeted_Metabolomics"])
            ids_g <- Reduce(c, clu_dt[c("RNA_Sequencing", 
                                        "WGB_DNA_Methylation")])
            
            
            enrich_m <- enricher(gene = unlist(ids_m), universe = NULL, 
                                pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                                TERM2GENE = integ_enrich_db[integ_enrich_db$type == "metabolite_id",], 
                                TERM2NAME = term2name_dt)
            enrich_g <- enricher(gene = unlist(ids_g), universe = NULL, 
                                pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                                TERM2GENE = integ_enrich_db[integ_enrich_db$type == "gene_id",], 
                                TERM2NAME = term2name_dt)
            
            if(is.null(enrich_m) & is.null(enrich_g)){
                return(NULL)
            } else if(!is.null(enrich_m) & is.null(enrich_g)){
                enrich_m <- setReadable_custom(enrich_m, featureDict = ids_m)
                return(enrich_m)
            } else if(!is.null(enrich_g) & is.null(enrich_m)){
                enrich_g <- setReadable_custom(enrich_g, featureDict = ids_g)
                return(enrich_g)
            }
            enrich_m <- setReadable_custom(enrich_m, featureDict = ids_m)
            enrich_g <- setReadable_custom(enrich_g, featureDict = ids_g)
    
            merged_enrich <- dplyr::full_join(x = enrich_g@result, y = enrich_m@result, by = "ID")
             
            merged_enrich$geneID <- paste(merged_enrich$geneID.x, 
                                          merged_enrich$geneID.y, 
                                        sep = "/")
            merged_enrich$pvalue <- sapply(merged_enrich$ID, function(id){
                p_vals <- merged_enrich[merged_enrich$ID == id, 
                                        c("pvalue.x", "pvalue.y")]
                survcomp::combine.test(p = p_vals, 
                                       weight = weight_table[id,], 
                                       method = "logit", 
                                       na.rm = T)    
            })
            merged_enrich$p.adjust <- p.adjust(merged_enrich$pvalue, 
                                                        method = "fdr")
            merged_enrich$qvalue <- enrich_g@qvalueCutoff
            merged_enrich$Count <- rowSums(cbind(merged_enrich$Count.x,
                                                merged_enrich$Count.y), 
                                            na.rm = TRUE)
            
            merged_enrich$Description <- merged_enrich$Description.x
            merged_enrich$Description[is.na(merged_enrich$Description)] <- merged_enrich$Description.y[is.na(merged_enrich$Description)]
            
            merged_enrich$GeneRatio <- mapply(FUN = function(x, y){
                if(any(is.na(x))){return(paste(y, collapse = "/"))}
                if(any(is.na(y))){return(paste(x, collapse = "/"))}
                paste(sum(as.numeric(x[1]), as.numeric(y[1]), na.rm = TRUE),
                    sum(as.numeric(x[2]), as.numeric(y[2]), na.rm = TRUE), sep = "/")
            }, x = strsplit(merged_enrich$GeneRatio.x, "/"), 
                y = strsplit(merged_enrich$GeneRatio.y, "/"))
            
            enrich_g@result <- merged_enrich
    
            enrich_g[order(enrich_g$Count, decreasing = TRUE),]
            # merged_enrich[merged_enrich$p.adjust <= 0.05,]
        })
    })
    names(factor_res) <- names(factor_dt)
    factor_res
})
names(enrich_results_partial) <- names(clu_ids_enrich)

results_wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
lapply(names(enrich_results_partial), function(factor_id){
    factor_dt <- enrich_results_partial[[factor_id]]
    lapply(names(factor_dt), function(weight_id){
        weight_dt <- factor_dt[[weight_id]]
        lapply(names(weight_dt), function(clu_id){
            clu_dt <- weight_dt[[clu_id]]
            sheet_name <- paste(factor_id, weight_id, clu_id, sep = ".")
            openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb = results_wb,
                                    sheetName = sheet_name)
            openxlsx::writeData(wb = results_wb, sheet = sheet_name,
                                x = as.data.frame(clu_dt))
        })
    })
    openxlsx::saveWorkbook(results_wb, 
                            file = paste0(enrich_nw_dir, "enrich_results.xlsx"), 
                            overwrite = TRUE)
})
```

```{r}
        x >= score_thr
    })
```

### Correlation filter

```{r}
rand_seed <- 1234
universe_list <- lapply(nw_graphs, function(score_dt){
    lapply(score_dt, function(graph_dt){
        names(V(graph_dt))
    })
})

nw_graphs <- lapply(names(nw_graphs), function(score_id){
    score_dt <- nw_graphs[[score_id]]
    score_res <- lapply(names(score_dt), function(graph_id){
        graph_dt <- score_dt[[graph_id]]

        graph_weights <- abs(edge_attr(graph_dt,
                        name = "weight"))
        graph_adj.p.val <- edge_attr(graph_dt, name = "adj.p.value")
        subgraph.edges(graph_dt,
                    E(graph_dt)[graph_weights >= score_filters[score_id] & graph_adj.p.val <= 0.05],
                    delete.vertices = FALSE)
    })
    names(score_res) <- names(score_dt)
    score_res
})
names(nw_graphs) <- score_names
```


### Extra analysis

#### Correlations RNA-Seq/DNA-Seq

```{r}
plot_list <- lapply(nw_graphs, function(score_dt){
    
    lapply(score_dt, function(factor_dt){
    
        test <- igraph::as_long_data_frame(factor_dt)
        rna_dna_omics <- c("RNA_Sequencing", "WGB_DNA_Methylation")
        
        
        rna_nodes <- names(V(factor_dt))[vertex_attr(factor_dt, name = "Node_Omic") == rna_dna_omics[1]]
        dna_nodes <- names(V(factor_dt))[vertex_attr(factor_dt, name = "Node_Omic") == rna_dna_omics[2]]
        
        test_dna_rna <- test[(test$to_Node_Omic %in% rna_dna_omics) & 
                 (test$from_Node_Omic %in% rna_dna_omics),]
        
        rna_seq_corr <- c(test_dna_rna$to_name[test_dna_rna$to_Node_Omic == rna_dna_omics[1]],
                          test_dna_rna$from_name[test_dna_rna$from_Node_Omic == rna_dna_omics[1]])
        dna_seq_corr <- c(test_dna_rna$to_name[test_dna_rna$to_Node_Omic == rna_dna_omics[2]],
                          test_dna_rna$from_name[test_dna_rna$from_Node_Omic == rna_dna_omics[2]])
        
        
        rna_table <- table(rna_seq_corr)
        dna_table <- table(dna_seq_corr)
        
        
        rna_count_dt <- data.frame("value" = as.numeric(rna_table),
                                   "value_perc" = as.numeric(rna_table)/length(dna_nodes),
                                    "name" = names(rna_table),
                                    "omic" = "RNA_Sequencing",
                                    "n_vars" = paste("Nt = ", length(rna_nodes),
                                                     "/ N = ", length(rna_table))
                                )
        
        dna_count_dt <- data.frame("value" = as.numeric(dna_table),
                                    "value_perc" = as.numeric(dna_table)/length(rna_nodes),
                                    "name" = names(dna_table),
                                    "omic" = "WGB_DNA_Methylation",
                                    "n_vars" = paste("Nt =", length(dna_nodes),
                                                     "/ N = ", length(dna_table))
                                   )
        count_merged_dt <- rbind(rna_count_dt, dna_count_dt)
        
        count_merged_dt$omic <- omic_names_dict[as.character(count_merged_dt$omic)]
        count_merged_dt
    })
})

```

What we see makes sense as we have smaller differences in DNA methylation data than in RNA-Seq data, from 602 significant DMRs to around ~10000 significant genes.

#### Correlations RNA-Seq/DNA-Seq

```{r}
plot_list <- lapply(nw_graphs$spearman, function(factor_dt){
    test <- igraph::as_long_data_frame(factor_dt)

    rna_dna_omics <- c("RNA_Sequencing", "WGB_DNA_Methylation")
    
    test_dna_rna <- test[(test$to_Node_Omic %in% rna_dna_omics) & 
             (test$from_Node_Omic %in% rna_dna_omics),]
    
    rna_table <- table(test_dna_rna$from_name)
    dna_table <- table(test_dna_rna$to_name)
    
    rna_count_dt <- data.frame("value" = as.numeric(rna_table),
                               "value_perc" = as.numeric(rna_table)/length(dna_table),
                                "name" = names(rna_table),
                                "omic" = unique(test_dna_rna$from_Node_Omic),
                                "n_vars" = paste("N = ", length(rna_table)))
    
    dna_count_dt <- data.frame("value" = as.numeric(dna_table),
                                "value_perc" = as.numeric(dna_table)/length(rna_table),
                                "name" = names(dna_table),
                                "omic" = unique(test_dna_rna$to_Node_Omic),
                                "n_vars" = paste("N =", length(dna_table)))
    count_merged_dt <- rbind(rna_count_dt, dna_count_dt)
    
    count_merged_dt$omic <- omic_names_dict[as.character(count_merged_dt$omic)]
    count_merged_dt
})

```

What we see makes sense as we have smaller differences in DNA methylation data than in RNA-Seq data, from 602 significant DMRs to around ~10000 significant genes.

```{r}
    theme_minimal() + facet_grid(rows = vars(omic)) +
```

##### Partial kegg joint pathway gsea

```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)
kegg_db_enrich_path <- paste0(params$output_dir, "kegg_enrich_db.rds")
kegg_db_list <- readRDS(kegg_db_enrich_path)
term2name_dt <- kegg_db_list$term2name
integ_enrich_db <- kegg_db_list$term2gene
membership_attribute <- "cluster_ids"
min_n <- 10
enrich_name <- "factor_part_kegg_gsea"
enrich_nw_dir <- paste0(corr_output_dir, enrich_name, "/")

if(!dir.exists(enrich_nw_dir)){dir.create(enrich_nw_dir)}

col_names <- paste0("Factor_", seq_len(num_factors))

fc_dict <- lapply(col_names, function(col_name){
    col_name <- paste0(col_name, "_weights")
    
    fc_dt <- rowData(omic_data)[[col_name]]
    
    omic_fc_dict <- mapply(function(omic_id, enrich_var){
        omic_data <- omic_dt[[omic_id]]
        omic_dict <- rowData(omic_dt)[[enrich_var]]
        names(omic_dict) <- paste0(omic_id, ".", rownames(omic_data))
        omic_fc <- mapply(function(var_names, fc_vect){
            var_names_split <- strsplit(var_names, ";")[[1]]
            var_names_split <- var_names_split[!is.na(var_names_split)]
            if(!length(var_names_split)){return(NULL)}
            fc_vect_dict <- rep(fc_vect, length(var_names_split))
            names(fc_vect_dict) <- var_names_split
            fc_vect_dict
        }, var_names = omic_dict, fc_vect = fc_dt, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
        unlist(omic_fc)
    }, omic_id = omic_enrich, enrich_var = ids_enrich_names)
})
names(fc_dict) <- col_names
```


```{r}
weight_table <- prop.table(table(integ_enrich_db$term, integ_enrich_db$type), margin = 1)

# universe_m <- unlist(Reduce(c, universe_list_ids["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]))
# universe_g <- unlist(Reduce(c, universe_list_ids[c("RNA_Sequencing", "WGB_DNA_Methylation")]))

enrich_results_partial <- lapply(names(clu_ids_enrich), function(factor_id){
    factor_dt <- clu_ids_enrich[[factor_id]]
    
    factor_res <- lapply(col_names, function(col_name){
        
        weight_dt <- factor_dt[["All"]]
        
        lapply(weight_dt, function(clu_dt){
            
            ids_m <- unlist(Reduce(c, clu_dt["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]))
            ids_m <- sort(fc_dict[[col_name]]$Untargeted_Metabolomics[ids_m],
                        decreasing = TRUE)
            
            ids_g <- unlist(Reduce(c, clu_dt["RNA_Sequencing"]))
            ids_g <- fc_dict[[col_name]]$RNA_Sequencing[ids_g]
            
            ids_d <- unlist(Reduce(c, clu_dt["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]))
            ids_d <- fc_dict[[col_name]]$WGB_DNA_Methylation[ids_d]
            ids_g <- sort(c(ids_g, ids_d), decreasing = TRUE)
            
            enrich_m <- GSEA(gene = ids_m, 
                                pvalueCutoff = 1, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                                TERM2GENE = integ_enrich_db[integ_enrich_db$type == "metabolite_id",], 
                                TERM2NAME = term2name_dt)
            enrich_g <- GSEA(gene = ids_g, 
                                pvalueCutoff = 1, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                                TERM2GENE = integ_enrich_db[integ_enrich_db$type == "gene_id",], 
                                TERM2NAME = term2name_dt)
            
            if(is.null(enrich_m) & is.null(enrich_g)){
                return(NULL)
            } else if(!is.null(enrich_m) & is.null(enrich_g)){
                enrich_m <- setReadable_custom(enrich_m, featureDict = ids_m)
                return(enrich_m)
            } else if(!is.null(enrich_g) & is.null(enrich_m)){
                enrich_g <- setReadable_custom(enrich_g, featureDict = ids_g)
                return(enrich_g)
            }
            enrich_m <- setReadable_custom(enrich_m, featureDict = ids_m)
            enrich_g <- setReadable_custom(enrich_g, featureDict = ids_g)
    
            merged_enrich <- dplyr::full_join(x = enrich_g@result, y = enrich_m@result, by = "ID")
             
            merged_enrich$geneID <- paste(merged_enrich$geneID.x, 
                                          merged_enrich$geneID.y, 
                                        sep = "/")
            merged_enrich$pvalue <- sapply(merged_enrich$ID, function(id){
                p_vals <- merged_enrich[merged_enrich$ID == id, 
                                        c("pvalue.x", "pvalue.y")]
                survcomp::combine.test(p = p_vals, 
                                       weight = weight_table[id,], 
                                       method = "logit", 
                                       na.rm = T)    
            })
            merged_enrich$p.adjust <- p.adjust(merged_enrich$pvalue, 
                                                        method = "fdr")
            merged_enrich$qvalue <- enrich_g@qvalueCutoff
            merged_enrich$Count <- rowSums(cbind(merged_enrich$Count.x,
                                                merged_enrich$Count.y), 
                                            na.rm = TRUE)
            
            merged_enrich$Description <- merged_enrich$Description.x
            merged_enrich$Description[is.na(merged_enrich$Description)] <- merged_enrich$Description.y[is.na(merged_enrich$Description)]
            
            merged_enrich$GeneRatio <- mapply(FUN = function(x, y){
                if(any(is.na(x))){return(paste(y, collapse = "/"))}
                if(any(is.na(y))){return(paste(x, collapse = "/"))}
                paste(sum(as.numeric(x[1]), as.numeric(y[1]), na.rm = TRUE),
                    sum(as.numeric(x[2]), as.numeric(y[2]), na.rm = TRUE), sep = "/")
            }, x = strsplit(merged_enrich$GeneRatio.x, "/"), 
                y = strsplit(merged_enrich$GeneRatio.y, "/"))
            
            enrich_g@result <- merged_enrich
            enrich_g
            # merged_enrich[merged_enrich$p.adjust <= 0.05,]
        })
    })
    names(factor_res) <- names(factor_dt)
    factor_res
})
names(enrich_results_partial) <- names(clu_ids_enrich)

results_wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
lapply(names(enrich_results_partial), function(factor_id){
    factor_dt <- enrich_results_partial[[factor_id]]
    lapply(names(factor_dt), function(weight_id){
        weight_dt <- factor_dt[[weight_id]]
        lapply(names(weight_dt), function(clu_id){
            clu_dt <- weight_dt[[clu_id]]
            sheet_name <- paste(factor_id, weight_id, clu_id, sep = ".")
            openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb = results_wb,
                                    sheetName = sheet_name)
            openxlsx::writeData(wb = results_wb, sheet = sheet_name,
                                x = as.data.frame(clu_dt))
        })
    })
    openxlsx::saveWorkbook(results_wb, 
                            file = paste0(enrich_nw_dir, "enrich_results.xlsx"), 
                            overwrite = TRUE)
})

```

```{r}
enrich_results_list <- lapply(names(clu_ids_enrich), function(score_id){
    factor_results <- lapply(names(clu_ids_enrich[[score_id]]), function(factor_id){
        enrich_results <- lapply(names(clu_ids_enrich[[score_id]][[factor_id]]), function(clu_id){
            clu_ids_list <- clu_ids_enrich[[score_id]][[factor_id]][[clu_id]]
            enrich_res <- enricher(
                gene = unlist(clu_ids_list), 
                universe = NULL, 
                pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                TERM2GENE = integ_enrich_db, TERM2NAME = term2name_dt)
            # if(nrow(as.data.frame(enrich_res)) == 0){return(NA)}
            # unlist(universe_list_ids)
            enrich_res <- setReadable_custom(enrich_res, 
                                            featureDict = Reduce(c, clu_ids_list))
            return(enrich_res)
        })
        names(enrich_results) <- names(clu_ids_enrich[[score_id]][[factor_id]])
        return(enrich_results[!is.na(enrich_results)])
    })
    names(factor_results) <- names(clu_ids_enrich[[score_id]])
    factor_results
})
```

```{r}
            universe_ids_list = universe_list_ids,
            var_order_col_list = var_order_col_list,
            omic_names_dict = omic_names_dict,
            omic_color_dict = omic_color_dict,
            omic_shape_dict = shape_vect_ext,
            group_color_dict = group_color_dict,
            feature_ids_dict = feature_ids_dict)
    )
)
```

#### Cluster network

```{r}
nw_graphs <- lapply(nw_graphs, function(score_dt){
    lapply(score_dt, function(graph_dt){
        # graph_dt <- subgraph(graph_dt, clusters(graph_dt))
        graph_dt <- decompose(graph_dt, max.comps = 1)[[1]]
        membership_dt <- membership(infomaps_website_clustering(
                                    graph = graph_dt, weights = abs(edge_attr(graph_dt, 
                                                                              name = "weight")),
                                    rand.seed = rand_seed, num_trials = 100))
        vertex_attr(graph_dt, name = "cluster_ids") <- paste0("CL_", membership_dt)
        return(graph_dt)
    })
})

table(vertex_attr(nw_graphs$spearman$Factor_1, "cluster_ids"))
table(vertex_attr(nw_graphs$spearman$Factor_2, "cluster_ids"))

lapply(names(nw_graphs), function(score_id){
    score_dt <- nw_graphs[[score_id]]
    lapply(names(score_dt), function(weight_id){
        graph_dt <- score_dt[[weight_id]]
        hist(table(vertex_attr(graph_dt, name = "cluster_ids")), breaks = 100)
    })
})
```

#### Cluster enrichment

```{r}
membership_attribute <- "cluster_ids"
min_n = 10;

library(clusterProfiler)

clu_ids_enrich <- lapply(nw_graphs, function(score_dt){
    lapply(score_dt, function(graph){
        membership_vector <- vertex_attr(graph, membership_attribute)
        clu_vertex <- lapply(unique(membership_vector), function(cl_id){
            names(V(graph))[membership_vector == cl_id]
        })
        names(clu_vertex) <- unique(membership_vector)
        cluster_id_list <-  lapply(clu_vertex, function(clu_ids){
            if(length(clu_ids) <= min_n){return(NA)}
            metabo_dt <- omic_dict_list[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]][grep("Untargeted_Metabolomics", 
                                                                            clu_ids, value = T)]
            metabo_dt <- metabo_dt[!is.null(metabo_dt)]
             
            metabo_dt <- metabo_dt[!is.na(metabo_dt)]
            
            wgb_dt <- omic_dict_list[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]][grep("WGB_DNA_Methylation", 
                                                                            clu_ids, value = T)]
            wgb_dt <- wgb_dt[!is.null(wgb_dt) & !is.na(wgb_dt)]
            
            rna_dt <- omic_dict_list[["RNA_Sequencing"]][grep("RNA_Sequencing", 
                                                                            clu_ids, value = T)]
            rna_dt <- rna_dt[!is.null(rna_dt) & !is.na(rna_dt)]
            
            return(list("Untargeted_Metabolomics" = metabo_dt, 
                        "RNA_Sequencing" = rna_dt,
                        "WGB_DNA_Methylation" = wgb_dt))
        })
        cluster_id_list[!is.na(cluster_id_list)]
    })
})

universe_list_ids <- lapply(nw_graphs, function(score_dt){
    lapply(score_dt, function(graph){
        
        universe_ids <- names(V(graph))
    
        metabo_dt <- omic_dict_list[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]][grep("Untargeted_Metabolomics", 
                                                                            universe_ids, value = T)]
        metabo_dt <- metabo_dt[!is.null(metabo_dt)]
        metabo_dt <- unlist(strsplit(metabo_dt, ";"))
        metabo_dt <- metabo_dt[!is.na(metabo_dt)]
        
        wgb_dt <- omic_dict_list[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]][grep("WGB_DNA_Methylation", 
                                                                        universe_ids, value = T)]
        wgb_dt <- wgb_dt[!is.null(wgb_dt) & !is.na(wgb_dt)]
        
        rna_dt <- omic_dict_list[["RNA_Sequencing"]][grep("RNA_Sequencing", 
                                                                        universe_ids, value = T)]
        rna_dt <- rna_dt[!is.null(rna_dt) & !is.na(rna_dt)]
            
        universe_ids_f <- list("Untargeted_Metabolomics" = metabo_dt, 
                               "WGB_DNA_Methylation" = wgb_dt, 
                               "RNA_Sequencing" = rna_dt)
        universe_ids_f
    })
})
```

```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)
kegg_db_enrich_path <- paste0(params$output_dir, "kegg_enrich_db.rds")
kegg_db_list <- readRDS(kegg_db_enrich_path)
term2name_dt <- kegg_db_list$term2name
integ_enrich_db <- kegg_db_list$term2gene
membership_attribute <- "cluster_ids"
min_n <- 10
enrich_name <- "clu_part_kegg"
enrich_nw_dir <- paste0(corr_output_dir, enrich_name, "/")

if(!dir.exists(enrich_nw_dir)){dir.create(enrich_nw_dir)}
```


```{r}
weight_table <- prop.table(table(integ_enrich_db$term, integ_enrich_db$type), margin = 1)

enrich_results_partial <- lapply(names(clu_ids_enrich), function(factor_id){
    factor_dt <- clu_ids_enrich[[factor_id]]
    factor_res <- lapply(names(factor_dt), function(weight_id){
        weight_dt <- factor_dt[[weight_id]]
        weight_res <- lapply(weight_dt, function(clu_dt){
            universe_dt <- universe_list_ids[[factor_id]][[weight_id]]
            
            ids_m <- Reduce(c, clu_dt["Untargeted_Metabolomics"])
            ids_g <- Reduce(c, clu_dt[c("RNA_Sequencing", 
                                        "WGB_DNA_Methylation")])
            
            universe_m <- unlist(Reduce(c, universe_dt["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]))
            universe_g <- unlist(Reduce(c, universe_dt[c("RNA_Sequencing",
                                                        "WGB_DNA_Methylation")]))
                    
            enrich_m <- enricher(gene = unlist(ids_m), universe = universe_m, 
                                pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                                TERM2GENE = integ_enrich_db, TERM2NAME = term2name_dt)
            
            enrich_g <- enricher(gene = unlist(ids_g), universe = universe_g, 
                                pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                                TERM2GENE = integ_enrich_db, TERM2NAME = term2name_dt)
            
            if(is.null(enrich_m) & is.null(enrich_g)){
                return(NULL)
            } else if(!is.null(enrich_m) & is.null(enrich_g)){
                enrich_m <- setReadable_custom(enrich_m, featureDict = ids_m)
                return(enrich_m)
            } else if(!is.null(enrich_g) & is.null(enrich_m)){
                enrich_g <- setReadable_custom(enrich_g, featureDict = ids_g)
                return(enrich_g)
            }
            enrich_m <- setReadable_custom(enrich_m, featureDict = ids_m)
            enrich_g <- setReadable_custom(enrich_g, featureDict = ids_g)

            merged_enrich <- dplyr::full_join(x = enrich_g@result, 
                                            y = enrich_m@result, 
                                            by = "ID")
            merged_enrich$geneID <- paste(merged_enrich$geneID.x, 
                                          merged_enrich$geneID.y, sep = "/")
            
            merged_enrich$pvalue <- sapply(merged_enrich$ID, function(id){
                p_vals <- merged_enrich[merged_enrich$ID == id, 
                                        c("pvalue.x", "pvalue.y")]
                if(any(is.na(p_vals))){
                    return(p_vals[!is.na(p_vals)])
                }
                survcomp::combine.test(p = p_vals, 
                                       weight = weight_table[id,], method = "logit")    
            })
            merged_enrich$p.adjust <- p.adjust(merged_enrich$pvalue, 
                                                        method = "fdr")
            merged_enrich$qvalue <- enrich_g@qvalueCutoff
            
            merged_enrich$Count <- rowSums(cbind(merged_enrich$Count.x,
                                                merged_enrich$Count.y), 
                                            na.rm = TRUE)
            
            merged_enrich$Description <- merged_enrich$Description.x
            merged_enrich$Description[is.na(merged_enrich$Description)] <- merged_enrich$Description.y[is.na(merged_enrich$Description)]
            
            merged_enrich$GeneRatio <- mapply(FUN = function(x, y){
                if(any(is.na(x))){return(paste(y, collapse = "/"))}
                if(any(is.na(y))){return(paste(x, collapse = "/"))}
                paste(sum(as.numeric(x[1]), as.numeric(y[1]), na.rm = TRUE),
                    sum(as.numeric(x[2]), as.numeric(y[2]), na.rm = TRUE), sep = "/")
            }, x = strsplit(merged_enrich$GeneRatio.x, "/"), 
                y = strsplit(merged_enrich$GeneRatio.y, "/"))
            
            
            merged_enrich$BgRatio <- mapply(FUN = function(x, y){
                if(any(is.na(x))){return(paste(y, collapse = "/"))}
                if(any(is.na(y))){return(paste(x, collapse = "/"))}
                paste(sum(as.numeric(x[1]), as.numeric(y[1]), na.rm = TRUE),
                    sum(as.numeric(x[2]), as.numeric(y[2]), na.rm = TRUE), sep = "/")
            }, x = strsplit(merged_enrich$BgRatio.x, "/"), 
                y = strsplit(merged_enrich$BgRatio.y, "/"))
            enrich_g@result <- merged_enrich[,c("ID", "Description", 
                                                "GeneRatio", "BgRatio", 
                                                "pvalue", "p.adjust", "qvalue", 
                                                "geneID", "Count")]
            enrich_g
        })
        weight_res[!sapply(weight_res, is.null)]
    })
    names(factor_res) <- names(factor_dt)
    factor_res
})

names(enrich_results_partial) <- names(clu_ids_enrich)

results_wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
lapply(names(enrich_results_partial), function(factor_id){
    factor_dt <- enrich_results_partial[[factor_id]]
    lapply(names(factor_dt), function(weight_id){
        weight_dt <- factor_dt[[weight_id]]
        lapply(names(weight_dt), function(clu_id){
            clu_dt <- weight_dt[[clu_id]]
            sheet_name <- paste(factor_id, weight_id, clu_id, sep = ".")
            openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb = results_wb,
                                    sheetName = sheet_name)
            openxlsx::writeData(wb = results_wb, sheet = sheet_name,
                                x = as.data.frame(clu_dt))
        })
    })
    openxlsx::saveWorkbook(results_wb, 
                            file = paste0(enrich_nw_dir, "enrich_results.xlsx"), 
                            overwrite = TRUE)
})
```

```{r}
enrich_results_list <- lapply(names(clu_ids_enrich), function(score_id){
    factor_results <- lapply(names(clu_ids_enrich[[score_id]]), function(factor_id){
        enrich_results <- lapply(names(clu_ids_enrich[[score_id]][[factor_id]]), function(clu_id){
            clu_ids_list <- clu_ids_enrich[[score_id]][[factor_id]][[clu_id]]
            enrich_res <- enricher(
                gene = unlist(clu_ids_list), 
                universe = unlist(universe_list_ids), 
                pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                TERM2GENE = integ_enrich_db, TERM2NAME = term2name_dt)
            # if(nrow(as.data.frame(enrich_res)) == 0){return(NA)}

            return(enrich_res)
        })
        names(enrich_results) <- names(clu_ids_enrich[[score_id]][[factor_id]])
        return(enrich_results[!is.na(enrich_results)])
    })
    names(factor_results) <- names(clu_ids_enrich[[score_id]])
    factor_results
})
```
